title: Amazon’s AWS Surge: 37% Growth Signals AI Payoff Amid Surging Capital Bets
description: Amazon's AWS posted 37% growth in Q2 2026, its fastest pace in 18 quarters, driving total revenue past $200B. Backlog hit $496B while capex rose to $220B amid AI demand. Margins expanded and shares jumped over 15%. The results validate heavy infrastructure bets.

title: Microsoft’s Azure Milestone Ignites 15% Stock Surge as AI Demand Outpaces Spending Fears
description: Microsoft's Q4 results showed $90B revenue and Azure crossing $100B annually with 43% growth, sending shares up over 15%. Strong Copilot adoption and measured capex eased AI spending worries while signaling continued momentum. The performance outpaced forecasts and lifted sector sentiment.

title: 'Has Human Voice But...': CJI Surya Kant Cautions Against Leaving Online Mediation To AI
description: Chief Justice Surya Kant emphasized the importance of human involvement in online mediation, highlighting that while AI can mimic human voices, it lacks the capacity for empathy and apology.

title: DocuSign shifts Brazil operations to AI contract management
description: DocuSign Brazil is shifting to an AI contract platform to help firms manage tax reform. Over 50% of small business agreements still exist only on paper.
